biography: Graduate from Southern Utah University’s MBA program, completed in May 2018 with a GPA of 4.0. I was awarded an academic scholarship and inducted into the Beta Gamma Sigma Honorary Business School Society. I have a strong managerial and analytical background in cost analysis, finance, and operations. Before pursuing an MBA full-time, I worked for Envision Management & Marketing out of Las Vegas, Nevada as a business consultant/analyst. While there, I specialized in financial and market analysis, capital budgeting, regression analysis, and management and staff training. I earned my undergraduate degree in economics from Southern Utah University. I am extremely goal driven and thrive in an environment that promotes critical thinking, problem solving, and working with a team to accomplish a unified objective.
